description: This Python source file provides various functions for extracting, parsing, and summarizing the contents of different document formats such as TXT, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX. It includes utilities for handling large files efficiently, inferring column types, grouping headers, and generating schema summaries and text slices for efficient indexing.
